name: SUNoise (scaled uniform noise)
plain: Ancestral samplers that alternate Gaussian and scaled-uniform noise by step, plus a NOISE node for initial noise. Uniform range depends on sigma_down. Multires variant adds half-resolution uniform values.
math:
Per-step (called with σ_down): r=σ_down.item(); gen seeded with seed+int(1000·r) each call; n=U(−r,r) per channel. Multires: n=U(0,1) at scale 1 + nearest-upscaled U(0,1) at scale ½; then remapped to [−r,r] by min and max.
Initial: scale fixed; n=U(−scale,scale); seed+int(1000·scale).
Euler ancestral: x ← x + d·dt, then odd steps x ← x + su(σ_down); even steps x ← x + N(0,I)·s_noise·σ_up (sunoise.py:157).

props.normalizes_variance: no: uniform ±r has std r/√3, and odd steps ignore s_noise and σ_up

label: from code
surprise: Even steps are plain Gaussian; only odd steps are uniform, and those skip both s_noise and σ_up (sunoise.py:157). The generator is reseeded per call from seed+int(1000σ).
